count_rule: unique modified plus added plus removed Architecture Element IDs per independent change
counting_notes: M-07 changes S2S timestamp/revision information. Candidate A does not consume S2S timestamp evidence, so its S2S conversation contract and behavior remain unchanged and the item is a zero-element regression-only verification.
Candidate B consumes native S2S aligned-text information, so M-07 modifies its adapter, normalized evidence contract, candidate handling and evidence session state.
A zero-element item remains in the QA-29 denominator because the change is applicable and the frozen functional regression must still pass.
